---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for AutoPiano
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or improvement you are proposing.

## ❓ Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.
*(e.g., "I'm always frustrated when I try to play sheets with complex polyphonic octave shifts...")*

## 💡 Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. How should the user interface or keyboard engine behave?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 🛡️ Offline-First & Community Compatibility

- [ ] Does this feature respect AutoPiano's 100% offline, local SQLite architecture?
- [ ] Does it require any external third-party cloud service or subscription? (Must be NO)

## 📋 Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or sheet examples about the feature request here.
